description: Rename an in-app placement or change its description or size hints. The key cannot change. Provide at least one field.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

height.description: Height hint in points (1-4000) for whoever writes the content; null clears it.

key.description: Placement key, the id app code passes to the SDK (from list_in_app_placements).

width.description: Width hint in points (1-4000) for whoever writes the content; null clears it.
